title: Tracxn - Senior Associate Product Manager
description:
**ABOUT TRACXN**

Tracxn is a leading global market intelligence platform tracking 7.9M + private companies across 3,000+ sectors and 50+ geographies. We turn deep data into decision-ready insights, powering deal sourcing, market mapping, and due diligence for 850+ clients worldwide, including VC firms, Private Equity, Investment Banks, and Corporates.

  

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

As an Associate Product Manager at Tracxn, youll support the product team in defining requirements, analyzing performance, and executing product initiatives across the lifecycle. You’ll collaborate with design, engineering, and senior PMs to translate ideas into impactful product features.

This role is ideal for early-career professionals eager to learn product fundamentals, work on a global B2B SaaS platform, and grow into a full-fledged Product Manager.

  

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* **Feature Specification:** Assist Product Managers in defining feature specifications and writing detailed product requirement documents (PRDs).
* **Collaboration:** Work closely with design, engineering, and operations teams to ensure smooth execution across the product lifecycle.
* **Performance Analysis:** Review and analyze key product metrics to track performance and identify improvement areas.
* **Design Support:** Collaborate with the UX team to create wireframes, mockups, and design documentation.
* **Data & Insights:** Use data and API tools (like Postman) to extract insights and validate product decisions.
*

title: Sr Manager-Digital Product Management
description:
Global Merchant & Network Services brings together American Express merchant and network-related businesses, including relationships with merchants, issuers, acquirers, processors, and strategic partners globally.

The Network Product team develops and delivers secure, resilient, and scalable payment network capabilities. This includes Authorization, Tokenization, Authentication, Digital Wallets, Local Network solutions, and Network-to-Network integrations that support market expansion, regulatory requirements, and global interoperability.

We are looking for an experienced Network Product professional to drive the development and delivery of strategic payment network capabilities. The role requires strong knowledge of payment networks, issuing, acquiring, transaction processing, and digital payments, along with the ability to translate business and partner needs into clear product requirements and executable delivery plans.

Strong project management, communication, and stakeholder management skills are critical. The individual will coordinate cross-functional workstreams, manage risks and dependencies, drive governance, and communicate progress and decisions effectively to senior leaders, internal teams, and external partners.
